dataDictionary.description: USC ADRC UDS/PTID participant identifier used for cross-source linkage.
Specimen collection/blood-draw/CSF visit date in YYYY-MM-DD. Date provenance is retained separately.
Original source collection-date value retained for provenance before date parsing/standardization; may be blank when the source provided no collection date.
Laboratory analysis date when supplied by the source; currently populated primarily for NCRAD.
NCRAD return/batch number when supplied by the upstream NCRAD release; blank for non-NCRAD sources.
NCRAD Flywheel batch Last Updated date when available. Distinct from specimen collection_date and analysis_date.
Provenance for batch_return_date, such as upstream NCRAD curated release or Flywheel Last Updated.
Specimen matrix, currently Plasma or CSF.
Harmonized analyte name. Same-name analytes from different protocols remain distinct via measurement_family_id/protocol_id.
Numeric biomarker measurement retained from the selected source record.

Source-supported measurement unit. For current NCRAD ABeta40, ABeta42, pTau217, NfL, and GFAP, missing upstream units are filled as pg/mL from the official NCRAD variable-description workbook. Values are not converted across units in v1.0.5.
Provenance of biomarker_unit, distinguishing upstream/source-provided units from temporary enrichment using the official NCRAD variable description.
Within-source assay/technical replicate number when available; NCRAD replicates are preserved.
High-level source family such as NCRAD, VCS_REDCap, Legacy_CSF, or C2N.
Specific imported dataset/instrument representation.
Defines analytical comparability/deduplication family. Different protocols are intentionally kept separate.
Protocol/assay grouping used to prevent inappropriate collapsing of non-interchangeable measurements.
Assay method when supported by the source (e.g., C2N IP-MS).
Assay platform when supported by the source. Numeric NCRAD codes are decoded using the official NCRAD variable description (1=Quanterix Simoa; 2=Fujirebio Lumipulse).
Original NCRAD assay-platform code when the upstream curated release supplied a coded value; blank for already-labeled/non-NCRAD sources.
Assay kit name when supported by the source. Numeric NCRAD assay-name codes are decoded using the official NCRAD variable description.
Original NCRAD assay-name code when the upstream curated release supplied a coded value; blank for already-labeled/non-NCRAD sources.
Assay version when supported by the source.
Assay lot number when supported by the source.
Study/project label supplied by the source.
Source visit/event/timepoint label.
Source-format generation, e.g. current_redcap, legacy_spreadsheet, fixed_c2n_file, or NCRAD source generation.
Measurement-level QC state. review_note means retained but accompanied by a source note requiring awareness.
Source note/QC text when available.
Internal precedence used only when selecting among overlapping representations of the same measurement family.
Original source filename from which the measurement was imported.
Original/source-derived row number where available.
Source field used to derive collection_date.
TRUE when collection_date is retained for provenance but excluded from dated availability/range calculations because source evidence indicates a likely date-entry error.

Explicit operational availability grouping. A: A-beta38/40/42; T: p-tau181/217; N: total tau/NFL; V: sPDGFRB; Other: ancillary analytes such as GFAP/neurogranin. Not a positivity/diagnostic classification.
Why this record was selected for the canonical Long release when overlapping representations existed.
